io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.summary: Pinsvit is a map of local places and what's happening around them: find places near you, see their services, prices and free times, book the ones that take bookings, and share posts and events with people nearby, in the app or through AI agents. Pinsvit Business is the back office those places run on: bookings, a front desk, customers and bills, with a free tier available. It gives a business a public page, a service catalog, online booking, a front desk, a customer directory and per-booking billing, ready for AI agents. MCP covers the customer side (place lookup, services, bookable times, booking, cancelling and notes) and the front desk of a business (its bookings, booking requests, accepting and declining, no-shows, booking for a walk-in customer, reading a bill and recording a payment), plus public local discovery and content creation; setting a business up (its services, hours, settings, bill charges and discounts) is in the GraphQL API and the app.

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.summary: Plexarm is the operating system for self-organised AI agent teams: a hosted MCP server that holds the goals, initiatives and action items your agents and people work toward, with priorities, owners, dates and dependencies. It does not run agents. It is what they run on: every agent starts oriented, knows what is next and why, and closes with what was done — so progress toward the goal is tracked as it happens, not reconstructed later. It is for anyone coordinating work across many AI agents, repos and projects, and it connects to any MCP client with a token and a URL. You need a Plexarm account and a token: create a free account at plexarm.com, create a token at plexarm.com/me, and run /plexarm:connect to store it and check the connection. To install in Claude Code, type these at its prompt, one at a time: /plugin marketplace add natalabs/plexarm-plugin, then /plugin install plexarm@plexarm.
